verdict.rationale: Gusto's docs confirm health insurance is offered as an integrated benefit (e.g., via SimplyInsured) alongside payroll, implying enrollment/deduction sync, but there is no detailed documentation of the actual deduction-to-payroll sync mechanics. A concrete hands-on account describes Gusto failing to properly terminate a health plan, causing months of billing issues, and another describes being unable to customize multi-state health plans, directly undercutting the claim that benefits administration works smoothly end-to-end. missing for 10: detailed docs on deduction/enrollment sync mechanics, resolution of the plan-termination/billing failure, and independent corroboration that sync works reliably.
